name: Reproducibility bundle
description: Write a zip with software versions, git state, parameters, input checksums, the recorded steps, the session script and the final catalog; verify a bundle by checking inputs and versions and re-running the processing.

params.name: bundle-file
params.label: Bundle file (.zip)
params.help: Where "Create Bundle" writes and "Verify" reads. Empty = ogf_bundle.zip in the session work directory.

params.name: include-inputs
params.label: Include copies of the input images
params.help: Off: only checksums and paths are stored (small bundle). On: verify works without the original files.

params.name: note
params.label: Note
params.help: Free text stored in the manifest.

params.name: rerun
params.label: Re-run the processing when verifying
params.help: Session bundles re-run the exported script in replay mode (minutes); off = integrity checks only (inputs, bundled files, software versions).

params.name: rtol
params.label: Relative tolerance for numbers
params.help: 0 = the re-run must be byte-identical; a small value accepts numerical noise from other library versions.

params.name: inputs-dir
params.label: Directory with the input files
params.help: Searched first (by file name) when the recorded paths do not exist any more.
